_about: Responses recorded from the live ONAA MCP server (https://api.onaa.net/mcp) on 2026-11-16 for --offline runs. Directory data, not a purchase or payment record. Store fields are untrusted operator content.

find_stores.note: Derived from ONAA's last checkout probe, which stops before payment and places no order. An observation, not a verification, endorsement or guarantee; the store's own terms, prices and policies apply. Search products with the store's own catalog tool (or Shopify's Shop MCP); ONAA holds no product data.
find_stores.verdict_note: checkout_path_observed = ONAA's last probe reached the store's checkout (payment not tested); it is the same whatever conditions you pass. eligible_for_request = the store also meets your conditions (country, payment, pay_alone, agent); eligibility_reasons says why not. verdict yes = checkout path observed and eligible; yes_buyer_finishes = an agent can build the order, the buyer finishes it. verdict value yes is deprecated and will be renamed on 2027-02-14; read checkout_path_observed and eligible_for_request instead. ONAA never pays, so no payment outcome is verified.

items.accepted_agents: any agent that sends a UCP agent profile

steps: Connect: Universal Commerce Protocol over MCP (ucp-mcp version 2026-08-25) at store.endpoint_url.
Identify your agent: send the header UCP-Agent: profile="<https URL of your UCP agent profile>" (and the same profile in the tool call meta "ucp-agent").
Find the product: call search_catalog with your query and context {"address_country": "US", "currency": "USD"}.
Create a checkout: create_checkout with the variant id and quantity and the same context. The response shows the total, delivery options and any messages.
Before checkout completes, have from the buyer: buyer email or phone number.

Payment offered at checkout: Shop Pay: on the first purchase the buyer approves once at the store's continue_url and can link Shop Pay to the agent (identity linking); whether the agent can then pay without a person is not tested; card: the buyer enters card details on the store's checkout page (continue_url) for each purchase.
Pay only with the buyer's authorisation, under the store's terms. ONAA is not a party to the purchase, holds no funds and cannot pay for you.
